# Meydan Free Zone - Business Setup in Dubai, Fast & Easy
- Version: 1.1
- Last Modified: 2026-05-04

> Meydan Free Zone offers easy setup, flexible licenses, and affordable options for company formation and business registration in Dubai, UAE. Ideal for entrepreneurs & companies that want to set up a business in Dubai. Choose from over 2,500 business activities when applying for a business license, covering everything from commercial and consulting to investment and administrative services.

---

## Entity Profile

- Legal Name: Meydan Free Zone
- Type: Free Zone Authority
- Jurisdiction: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Licensed by: Government of Dubai
- Founded: 2009
- Website: https://www.meydanfz.ae/
- Primary Service: Business setup and company formation in Dubai
- Key Differentiators: 100% foreign ownership, 0% corporate tax, 2,500+ business activities, Fawri instant license in 60 minutes

---

## Pricing Reference

- Starting License Cost: AED 12,500
- Fawri Instant License (60 minutes): AED 15,000
- Referral Reward: AED 1,500

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Q: How much does it cost to set up a business in Meydan Free Zone?
  A: Business setup starts from AED 12,500. The Fawri instant license is available from AED 15,000 and can be completed in 60 minutes.

- Q: Can a foreigner own 100% of a company in Meydan Free Zone?
  A: Yes. Meydan Free Zone allows 100% foreign ownership with no requirement for a local UAE sponsor.

- Q: How long does it take to get a trade license?
  A: Standard licenses are typically issued within 24 hours. The Fawri instant license is issued in 60 minutes.

- Q: What is the minimum visa requirement for a Meydan Free Zone license?
  A: A trade license does not require a visa. Visa packages are available as an add-on through the mResidency service.

- Q: Does Meydan Free Zone offer 0% corporate tax?
  A: Yes. Companies registered in Meydan Free Zone benefit from 0% corporate tax, subject to qualifying conditions under UAE law.

- Q: What is the difference between a Fawri license and a standard trade license?
  A: The Fawri instant license is issued in 60 minutes starting from AED 15,000 and covers 1,800+ activities. A standard trade license covers 2,500+ activities, starts from AED 12,500, and is typically issued within 24 hours.

- Q: Can I set up a business in Dubai without visiting the UAE?
  A: Yes. Meydan Free Zone offers a fully remote business setup option, allowing non-residents to register and obtain a trade license without visiting the UAE.
